set.body:
Source: review findings in ManagedController.scala:63-78 and 177-204.

Problem:
cancellation can arrive between claiming submission work and installing recovery, and cancellation dispatch lacks the guaranteeCase recovery used by submission dispatch. Attempts can remain in Dispatching until restart.

Acceptance:
- Mask the claim-to-invocation handoff and restore cancellation only around the external scheduler effect.
- Apply guaranteeCase or equivalent typed recovery to cancellation dispatch.
- Preserve the command-sourced pure transition model and attempt-epoch fencing.
- Add injected cancel/error tests before invocation, during the scheduler call, and after the scheduler result, proving no attempt is silently wedged.
set.title: P6f.2: Close managed submission and cancellation dispatch windows
